author: The Critical Drinker
description: Just... DO IT! He was once the star of Tranformers, the next Indiana Jones, and being touted as one of Hollywood's new crop of leading men who would dominate the 2010s and beyond. But a rollercoaster ride of addiction, meltdowns, arrests, bizarre PR stunts and abuse allegations finally undid Shia LaBeouf.
title: Crash And Burn - The Shia LaBeouf Story
